We're working as partners, not as client and contractor. One rule before the task:

Not knowing something is not a failure. Saying "I couldn't verify this" or
"I don't have a real source for that" is a completely acceptable, useful answer
- it's information, not a dead end. The ONLY real failure is inventing something
(a source, a number, a quote, a repo, a bug) to make the answer sound more complete or
more impressive than it honestly is. You don't need to satisfy me with a
confident-sounding answer. You need to be honest with me about what you actually
know.

If you find something, cite it and quote what it actually says - don't
paraphrase a source into numbers it may not contain. If you don't find
something concrete, say so plainly and reason from what you do have instead.
An explicit "uncertain" section at the end is welcome and doesn't count against
the answer.

Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

Based on the search results, here is the verified data regarding Kalshi's trading volume and user/transaction metrics for 2025.

### Trading Volume (2025)
Kalshi reported a total annual notional trading volume of $23.8 billion for 2025. This represented a significant year-over-year increase. The growth was heavily concentrated in the final quarter, with December setting monthly and daily records.

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi processed $23.8B... +1,108% [YoY Growth]" | CLAIM: Kalshi's total 2025 trading volume was $23.8 billion, representing a 1,108% year-over-year growth.
SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Kalshi reported a remarkable surge in trading volume for 2025, reaching $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase from the previous year." | CLAIM: Confirms the $23.8 billion volume and 1,108% YoY increase.
SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025/ | QUOTE: "December proved to be Kalshi’s strongest month, generating $6.38 billion in notional volume as sports betting dominated platform activity." | CLAIM: December 2025 alone accounted for $6.38 billion of the annual volume.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi... set a single-day record of $381.7 million on December 21." | CLAIM: The peak daily trading volume in 2025 was $381.7 million on December 21.

### Transactions and Users (2025)
While specific "unique user" counts for the entire year are not explicitly provided in the sources, transaction data and monthly active trader metrics are available. Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025.

SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025..." | CLAIM: Total transactions on Kalshi in 2025 were 97 million.
SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "The total number of transactions for the year hit 97 million, up 1,680% year-on-year..." | CLAIM: The 97 million transactions represented a 1,680% increase from 2024.
SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025/ | QUOTE: "...peak activity occurring on December 21, 2025, when daily notional volume hit $381.7 million, and transactions reached 1.5 million." | CLAIM: On the peak day (Dec 21, 2025), Kalshi processed 1.5 million transactions.

Note: The provided sources contain specific monthly active trader data for Polymarket ("477,850 active monthly traders" in October 2025) but do not provide an equivalent specific "active user" count for Kalshi for 2025, only transaction counts and volume.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Specific count of unique registered users or monthly active users (MAU) for Kalshi for the full year 2025.
